scripts.convex:migrations:run: mise exec -- bunx convex run migrations:run
scripts.convex:migrations:run:prod: mise exec -- bunx convex run --prod migrations:run
scripts.auth:schema:check: bun run auth:schema:generate && git diff --exit-code -- src/generated/authSchema.ts
scripts.convex:env: SITE_URL=http://localhost:3000 && convex env set BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=$(openssl rand -base64 32) && convex env set SITE_URL $SITE_URL && convex env set BETTER_AUTH_ADMIN_EMAILS admin@gmail.com && convex run generated/auth:getLatestJwks | convex env set JWKS && (grep -q '^VITE_SITE_URL=' ../../.env.local && sed -i "s|^VITE_SITE_URL=.*|VITE_SITE_URL=$SITE_URL|" ../../.env.local || printf "\nVITE_SITE_URL=%s\n" "$SITE_URL" >> ../../.env.local)
